purpose: Describe the already revealed FAS-00 context-versus-entity transfer asymmetry using only existing global-mean features and frozen Phase 3 scores.

data_selection.population: Phase 3 frozen test partition: world seeds 24..31, qualification template 5, non-null observation_text for target-transfer comparisons.
data_selection.context_slice: context_term_id == 3; preserve each canonical exact-target class and its support.
data_selection.entity_slice: entity_term_id == 7; preserve each canonical exact-target class and its support.
data_selection.frozen_probe: HELDOUT_TERM_EXACT_TARGET from the sealed Phase 3 result; read parameters only, never refit.

fixed_descriptive_outputs.rule: Reconstruct 3x3 exact-target confusion matrices from the existing Phase 3 row scores for test_context_term_3 and test_entity_term_7; report class support and balanced accuracy by world family, task structure, feedback condition, relation ID, and world seed. Report missing-class groups as undefined rather than dropping them.

Apply the already fitted HELDOUT_TERM_EXACT_TARGET W, b, training mean, and training scale to the existing FULL vectors; margin is true-class logit minus the maximum other-class logit. Report median, 25th and 75th percentiles, and fraction <= 0 for both declared slices and the same fixed subgroups.

Within each cell (world family, task structure, feedback condition, relation ID, exact target, observation answer index) containing at least five rows for each compared term, compute raw FULL-feature centroid cosine distance and per-term median raw cosine distance to its own centroid. Compare context terms 2 versus 3 while holding entity_term_id fixed, and entity terms 4 versus 7 while holding context_term_id fixed. Report every eligible cell and the number of ineligible cells; no cell selection by outcome.

For the same selected events, compute FULL minus QUERY_ONLY feature-vector L2 norm and FULL/QUERY_ONLY cosine similarity; report median and quartiles by declared slices and fixed subgroups. This describes the added observation-bearing input, not a token-local representation.

metrics.distance_accumulation: float64 on the existing serialized float32 vectors
metrics.quartiles: nearest-rank at 25, 50, and 75 percent; report exact sample count
metrics.class_support: Report all support; no new pass/fail threshold is applied to descriptive groups.

scientific_status: Exploratory anatomy of a revealed FAS-00 qualification result; not an independent generalization test and not a representation selection gate.
